metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi{\b MIDI Sequencer SuperGnome}\line\line Generative euclidean drum + synth sequencer for REAPER (JSFX).\line\line Up to 8 drum lanes (sample playback or MIDI out), plus bass, melody and chord synth sections with a master key, scales (including Pelog, Slendro and quarter-tone Rast), harmonic progressions, swing, nudge, per-lane filters and LFOs. Everything phase-locked to project beat 0.\line\line Installs a small DR-55 starter sample pack (kick, snare, rim) into Data/supergnome - lanes 1-3 load them by default. Drop your own WAVs into Data/supergnome to extend the palette.\line\line Insert it on a track as "JS: MIDI Sequencer SuperGnome" and press play.}

version.author: joade comack
version.changelog: First packaged release. - MIDI Sequencer SuperGnome JSFX (drum lanes + bass/melody/chords, master key, stems on 24 channels) - DR-55 starter samples (bd, sn, rim) installed to Data/supergnome, loaded on lanes 1-3 by default

version.author: joade comack
version.changelog: Six synth engines, the synth drum, and web parity. - ENG on each synth section picks the voice: OSC / STR (plucked string) / GLS (glass) / DRN (throat-song drone) / BEL (bell + gong) / PNO (piano), each with one contextual knob (CYC / OPEN / STK / PED) - Drum lanes get a second field page: the PATTERN / VOICE button flips the row to SYN NSE SWP SUB CLK VOL CRP. SYN turns a lane into the internal synth drum - swept sine body, noise burst, click and 30Hz sub - instead of a sample or MIDI - Saved state now matches the browser port offset for offset, so a groove means the same thing in both. Older saves load unchanged

version.name: 1.2.0-beta1
version.author: joade comack
version.changelog: BLEEDING EDGE - untested. GEN KEY and the FX rack. - GEN KEY: the in-key generator from the browser port. The style box on the KEY row (after the B M C locks) picks free / Onon / Paln / Kaltuel / Roke / Ark / Atuan and sets the master scale to match; RIGHT-CLICK a section's RND button to write that part in the key and style. Left-click still does the old key-independent random - FX rack: dub delay (wow, pitched and reversed repeats, golden echo), glitch/stutter with bit crush, and a 24-grain granulator with a feedback tail. They run in parallel, each hearing only its own sends. The FX RACK button (top right) opens the page; the RACK cell is the master switch and starts off - SENDS matrix: four instrument rows plus one per drum lane, so the snare can swim in delay while the kick stays dry Saved projects are unaffected - the format is unchanged from 1.1.0. This build has never been compiled by its author; if it fails to load, install 1.1.0 from the version list.
